quote: In this paper, we investigate the ability of several current LLMs to generate age-appropriately simplified stories for children, as well as an examination of how modern lexical simplification models generalize to the domain of children's stories to enhance their educational potential.
We examine and compare the ability of several LLMs to adjust for age-appropriate levels of readability and lexical simplicity in automatically generated and individualized educational stories.
